query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total!"
               FROM catalog_card cc
               WHERE ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR cc.set_code = $2)
                 AND ($1::TEXT IS NULL
                      OR cc.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR $1 <% cc.name
                      OR cc.french_name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR $1 <% cc.french_name)
